name: Steel Cloud Road
text:
Activate Cast a Spell (add 1 action)

---
This carved iron cloud appears unfinished and full of spurs, blemishes, and other imperfections. When used as a catalyst to cast a Weapon Storm spell, the caster's weapon propels them forward. Before choosing the spell's area, Stride up to twice your Speed. This movement must be in a straight line and doesn't trigger reactions. The spell is then cast from your new location.
